Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]. It is the first volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series, and it was first published in [[June]] [[1995]] by [[Berkley Boulevard]]. The novel is set in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], and it follows fourteen-year-old twins [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] during their time at the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The novel was reprinted in the collections ''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Rise of the Shadow Academy]]'' ([[1996]]) and ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Shadow]]'' ([[2002]]).
